test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_json_array_of_objects_src SELECT concat('{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"key', toString((number % 10) * 30 + i), '":', multiIf(i % 4 = 0, toString(number + i), i % 4 = 1, concat('"s', toString(number % 100), '"'), i % 4 = 2, concat('[{"name":"n', toString(i), '","value":', toString(number % 1000), ',"tags":["a","b"]},{"name":"m","flag":true}]'), if(number % 2 = 0, toString(number % 7), concat('"', toString(number % 7), '"')))), range(30)), ','), '}') FROM numbers(100000)
